## What's new

- **`rclone mount` on Windows and macOS.** The release is now built
  the way upstream builds its releases, with upstream's
  `bin/cross-compile.go` and the same build tags, cgo settings and
  FUSE libraries for each platform, so `rclone mount` is included
  everywhere upstream has it and `rclone version` shows
  `go/tags: cmount` on Windows and macOS. As with official rclone,
  mounting needs [WinFsp](https://winfsp.dev/) on Windows and
  [macFUSE](https://osxfuse.github.io/) or
  [FUSE-T](https://www.fuse-t.org/) on macOS.
- **Every platform upstream releases.** Besides the platforms of
  earlier releases there are now builds for linux arm (v5), mips and
  mipsle, freebsd 386 and arm, and netbsd, openbsd, plan9, solaris and
  aix.
- **The manual includes the KamPlexFS docs.** `README.txt`,
  `README.html` and `rclone.1` in the zips are made from the fork's
  docs.

## Fixes

- `rclone rmdir` of a bucket holding only empty folders now fails with
  "directory not empty" in the `kamplexfs` backend instead of deleting
  the bucket with its folders.
- Removing a missing bucket with a token limited by `allowed_prefixes`
  now reports that the directory isn't found instead of failing
  because the token can't list the buckets.
